The edit distance of 0.606 sits inside the fine-tuned range (0.56-0.65) and is clearly below system-prompted. Stage directions are unchanged (1.6% vs 1.6%), which argues against a system prompt, since those usually raise stage-direction rates. Four refusals dropped fits fine-tuned (0-5 dropped), while quantized allows at most 1 and system-prompted at most 4. System-prompted is the closest alternative, given the early divergence and the 4 dropped refusals, but the edit distance and unchanged stage directions favor fine-tuned.
